sarah.docs: FYI I opened a docs PR to replace manual cursor examples with resume helper across py/ts/go. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/487
david.sdk: Nice. Helper handles resume tokens, TTL, and retryable cursor errors. Added minimal examples for each language.
lee.ts: I left a tiny type suggestion for the TS snippet (Generic<Result> change). Also asked to show streaming + resume usage together.
marco.go: Added Go snippet illustrating context cancellation and handling RetryableCursorError to fall back to cheaper model.
anya.qa: Can we add a deterministic test for TTL expiry in the preview? I want to reproduce the fallback behavior.
pr-bot: PR 487: docs-preview build queued. Files changed: 3 snippets, 1 migration note.
david.sdk: I'll add a small Node unit that simulates TTL and asserts RecoverableCursorError is returned. Also plan to export helper top-level in next SDK patch.
sarah.docs: Please include a short migration note in the docs page and the changelog blurb when merging. Request squash merge.
lee.ts: Once CI passes I'll do a final look at wording for streaming examples.
anya.qa: Assigning QA to run preview smoke and TTL scenario test tomorrow.
file_description: coordination thread for updating docs snippets to resume helper across Python/TypeScript/Go, includes PR link, QA plan, TS/Go notes
